questions.stem: A Boolean function of 6 variables is true on exactly 50 assignments. How many minterms appear in its canonical sum-of-products form?
questions.explanation: Each assignment on which the function is true contributes exactly one minterm, so a function true on 50 assignments has 50 minterms in its canonical sum-of-products form. The required result is 50.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.learningObjective: Solve problems involving boolean expressions and simplification.
questions.stem: A Boolean function of 7 variables is false on exactly 111 assignments. How many maxterms appear in its canonical product-of-sums form?
questions.explanation: Each assignment on which the function is false yields one maxterm in the canonical product-of-sums form, so the count is 2 to the 7 minus 111, namely 17. The required result is 17.
